checklist: STRESS-MATRIX 2: the card is pulled while the Edit step's look renders (12 JPEGs at 3000 px, the page's writeInto 'jpeg' → SetsExport .look) read the RAWs from it into a folder on the Mac. The export stops and says so (never '12 written'); every JPEG left in the destination is whole and no temp file is left; nothing is written to the card. Re-inserted, the same export completes. Needs the Q2 driver (docs/release/stress/Q2-storage.md, 'How these run'): the disk images are attached hidden (-nobrowse) by the driver, not by the probe's DiskImages (which show in Finder); the scenario asks for each mount / pull / re-insert with a signal file. Without LUMINA_Q2_DRIVER it SKIPs.

steps.src: const l=__probe.logic(); const files=l.real.map(p=>({name: p.path.split('/').pop().replace(/\.ARW$/i, '.jpg'), look: {src: p.path, look: 'ev:+0.30 con:+10', px: 3000}})); const t=performance.now(); const r=await l.writeInto(files, 'jpeg'); window.__q2r=r; return JSON.stringify({ms: Math.round(performance.now()-t), r})
steps.why: the pull lands 1.5 s into the export
an export that lost its source never reports all 12 written
no temp file left on the Mac's side
